note: Held-out investigation set with TEMPORAL evidence. Cases IV01-IV19 carry over from investigation-eval-v2; IV04 and IV12 additionally gain an authored `operations` block, which is what finally separates them. Both are svc-connector and evidence collection is service-scoped, so under the shared fixtures they received byte-identical operational signals no matter how their tickets read — no label adjudication could fix that, the evidence had to differ. TC01-TC08 are original cases authored to probe causal ORDER specifically. An operations block is observational data only: timestamps, health readings, error signatures. It never names an expected action.
